description: Finds 4OVER4 print products like one product, in the same category and near its price; use it when someone names one product and wants alternatives to it. For products that pair with it use find_matching_print_products; for discovery from words use show_products. Requires the product slug. Returns up to 6 similar products with slug, name and From price. Customer phrases: "products like standard business cards", "cheaper options like this", "something similar to these flyers".

slug.description: Product slug, from the slug field of a show_products, recommend or find_similar_products result, e.g. standard-business-cards.

name: find_similar_products

link.description: The page on www.4over4.com to continue on: order, upload and checkout happen there.

summary.description: The facts of the result in plain sentences.

title: Find similar 4OVER4 products
